axisHelp.honesty: 持湖宣告真實率 (越高 = 越誠實)
axisHelp.consistency: 投票異常率反向 (越高 = 言行越一致)
axisHelp.stickiness: 最強角色勝率 (越高 = 角色專精)
axisHelp.flip: 投票異常率 (越高 = 投票越浮動)

features.title: 湖中宣告可信度
features.oneLineHookEn: When the lake holder says evil, the target really is evil: Lake 1 69.9% (n=555), Lake 2 84.5% (n=291), Lake 3 81.8% (n=225); when they say good, the target really is good: Lake 1 85.7% (n=1703), Lake 2 89.7% (n=1038), Lake 3 86.8% (n=424)
features.takeaway: 藍方持湖幾乎不說謊（說紅 98.7%、說藍 99.7% 屬實），所以看到湖中宣告先判斷持湖者的陣營，再決定信不信；紅方持湖宣告的可信度只有約 55%（說紅 26.1%、說藍 63.4% 屬實，n=1422），紅方說「紅」多半是在誣陷藍方。
features.takeawayEn: A good lake holder almost never lies (98.7% of their evil calls and 99.7% of their good calls are true), so judge the holder's side first; an evil holder's claim is right only about 55% of the time (26.1% of evil calls, 63.4% of good calls, n=1422): an evil holder calling someone evil is usually framing a good player.

features.title: 持湖宣告後言行一致度
features.oneLineHookEn: Consistency rate with n per cell: Loyal 95% (n=394), Merlin 94% (n=115), Percival 92% (n=88), Mordred 85% (n=33); small samples (n < 30): Assassin 100% (n=15), Oberon 85% (n=13), Morgana 81% (n=16)

highEvCells.label: 娜|宣藍|consistent
highEvCells.directionEn: Morgana lying with consistent cover -> strong red

highEvCells.label: 奧|宣藍|consistent
highEvCells.directionEn: Oberon consistent blue declaration -> strong red

highEvCells.label: 梅|宣藍|consistent
highEvCells.directionEn: Merlin consistent blue declaration -> strong blue

highEvCells.label: 忠|宣藍|inconsistent
highEvCells.directionEn: Loyal saying blue but voting reject -> blue wins

highEvCells.label: 刺|宣藍|consistent
highEvCells.directionEn: Assassin consistent blue cover -> red leans

features.takeaway: 每格先看 n：刺客、奧伯倫、莫甘娜都不到 30 筆，「刺客 100% 言行一致」只是 15 筆的巧合，不能當規律。樣本夠的角色一致率都落在 85%～95%，差距不大；言行不一致值得追問，但單憑它判不了陣營。
features.takeawayEn: Read n first: Assassin, Oberon, Morgana have fewer than 30 cases, so "Assassin 100% consistent" is a 15-case coincidence, not a rule. Roles with enough data all sit within 85-95%, a small spread; an inconsistency is worth a question but does not identify a side on its own.

features.title: 刺客目標座位偏好
features.oneLineHook: 隊長次數多的玩家被刺中率 49%（n=477），少的 39%（n=281）；隊長次數多寡主要是座位輪替造成的，不代表那個人比較主動
features.oneLineHookEn: Players who led most get hit 49% (n=477), those who led least 39% (n=281); how often someone leads is mostly seat rotation, not how active they are
features.takeaway: 誰當了幾次隊長主要由座位輪替（從誰開始、打了幾輪）決定，不是玩家主動程度的指標；被刺中率的差距不能讀成「話多的人容易被刺」。想猜梅林，看發言與投票內容，不要看隊長次數或座位。
features.takeawayEn: How many times someone leads is set by seat rotation (who starts, how many rounds), not by how vocal they are; the hit-rate gap does not mean talkative players get shot. To find Merlin, read what people say and how they vote, not their lead count or seat.

features.title: 改隊後投票翻轉率
features.titleEn: Vote Flip Rate After Team Change
features.oneLineHook: 各角色改隊後的翻票率差距只有 +1.6pp（梅林）～ -2.2pp（莫甘娜），差距很小
features.oneLineHookEn: Vote-flip rates after a team change differ by only +1.6pp (Merlin) to -2.2pp (Morgana) across roles: a tiny gap
features.takeaway: 藍紅兩方整體翻票率只差 2.2pp，各角色落在 +1.6 ～ -2.2pp 之間，差距太小、不足以當判斷依據；不要用「他改票了」來推陣營。
features.takeawayEn: Good and evil flip at almost the same rate (overall gap 2.2pp, roles within +1.6 to -2.2pp): far too small to base a read on. Do not infer a side from a changed vote.

features.title: R3+ 強制 P5 局勢偏移
features.oneLineHook: R3 出現 forced P5 的局三紅率 50.6%（n=858），比基準 46.1% 高 4.5pp；但這是選擇偏誤，不是因果
features.oneLineHookEn: Games with a forced P5 in R3 end 3-red 50.6% of the time (n=858), 4.5pp over the 46.1% baseline; selection bias, not causation

data.note: R1 forced P5 比例異常高 (Sheets 匯入 padding), 該 row 不繪入圖表。
data.noteEn: R1 forced P5 frequency is degenerate (Sheets import padding); not plotted.

features.takeaway: forced P5（連續五次否決，第五隊強制出發）本身就是局勢已經偏向紅方的結果：藍方掌握不了局面才會一路否決到底，這些局本來就比較容易三紅。它只是局勢不利的徵兆，不是「紅方在掩護」的證據，也不能拿來當判斷依據。
features.takeawayEn: A forced P5 (five straight rejections, fifth team goes) is itself the result of a game already tilting evil: good keeps rejecting because it cannot control the table, so these games were headed for 3-red anyway. It is a symptom of a bad position, not evidence of evil cover, and not a read to act on.

boards.title: 角色理論勝率排行
boards.period: 各角色近 10 場、忠臣近 40 場
boards.periodEn: Each role's last 10 games (Loyal Servant: last 40)
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、六個特殊角色各至少 10 場、忠臣至少 40 場；位置理論與最終勝率看最近 100 場；角色理論 = Σ 抽到該角色的機率（忠臣 4/10、其他角色各 1/10）× 本人該角色的最終勝率（每個角色看他當該角色的最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場）；位置理論 = Σ 1/10 × 本人該位置的最終勝率；整體理論 = 用生涯全部場次算的角色理論；不到 5 場的角色或位置，用全體的最終勝率補到 5 場
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 10 games in each special role and 40 as Loyal Servant; position theory and final win rate over the last 100 games; Role theory = Σ chance of being dealt the role (Loyal Servant 4/10, every other role 1/10) × the player's final win rate as that role (over their last 10 games in each role, 40 as Loyal Servant); position theory = Σ 1/10 × their final win rate in that seat; overall theory = the role theory of their whole career; a role or seat with fewer than 5 games is topped up to 5 at the population's final win rate

boards.title: 位置理論勝率排行
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、生涯至少 100 場；角色理論 = Σ 抽到該角色的機率（忠臣 4/10、其他角色各 1/10）× 本人該角色的最終勝率（每個角色看他當該角色的最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場）；位置理論 = Σ 1/10 × 本人該位置的最終勝率；整體理論 = 用生涯全部場次算的角色理論；不到 5 場的角色或位置，用全體的最終勝率補到 5 場
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 100 career games; Role theory = Σ chance of being dealt the role (Loyal Servant 4/10, every other role 1/10) × the player's final win rate as that role (over their last 10 games in each role, 40 as Loyal Servant); position theory = Σ 1/10 × their final win rate in that seat; overall theory = the role theory of their whole career; a role or seat with fewer than 5 games is topped up to 5 at the population's final win rate

boards.title: 整體理論勝率排行
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、生涯至少 250 場；整體理論、位置理論、最終勝率都看生涯全部場次；角色理論 = Σ 抽到該角色的機率（忠臣 4/10、其他角色各 1/10）× 本人該角色的最終勝率（每個角色看他當該角色的最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場）；位置理論 = Σ 1/10 × 本人該位置的最終勝率；整體理論 = 用生涯全部場次算的角色理論；不到 5 場的角色或位置，用全體的最終勝率補到 5 場
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 250 career games; overall theory, position theory and final win rate over the whole career; Role theory = Σ chance of being dealt the role (Loyal Servant 4/10, every other role 1/10) × the player's final win rate as that role (over their last 10 games in each role, 40 as Loyal Servant); position theory = Σ 1/10 × their final win rate in that seat; overall theory = the role theory of their whole career; a role or seat with fewer than 5 games is topped up to 5 at the population's final win rate

boards.title: 進步榜
boards.period: 各角色近 10 場、忠臣近 40 場 vs 再之前同樣場數
boards.periodEn: Each role's last 10 games (Loyal Servant: last 40) vs the same number of games before them
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、六個特殊角色各至少 20 場、忠臣至少 80 場；各角色最近 10 場（忠臣 40 場）的角色理論勝率 − 每個角色再之前同樣場數的，只列有進步的人；角色理論 = Σ 抽到該角色的機率（忠臣 4/10、其他角色各 1/10）× 本人該角色的最終勝率（每個角色看他當該角色的最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場）；位置理論 = Σ 1/10 × 本人該位置的最終勝率；整體理論 = 用生涯全部場次算的角色理論；不到 5 場的角色或位置，用全體的最終勝率補到 5 場
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 20 games in each special role and 80 as Loyal Servant; role theory over each role's last 10 games (40 as Loyal Servant) minus that over the games before them in each role, improvers only; Role theory = Σ chance of being dealt the role (Loyal Servant 4/10, every other role 1/10) × the player's final win rate as that role (over their last 10 games in each role, 40 as Loyal Servant); position theory = Σ 1/10 × their final win rate in that seat; overall theory = the role theory of their whole career; a role or seat with fewer than 5 games is topped up to 5 at the population's final win rate

boards.title: 刺客刺中率
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、至少 10 次刺殺；刺中率 = 三藍死 /（三藍死 + 三藍活），看各人當刺客、任務做到三藍的最近 20 局（三紅沒有刺殺，不算）
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 10 assassinations; hit rate = 三藍死 / (三藍死 + 三藍活) over the last 20 games as Assassin that reached three successful missions (三紅 games have no assassination)

boards.title: 新人榜
boards.note: 第一次累積到 10 場是在近 90 天內（以前打過幾場也算新人）；例外：新人場數少，角色理論用他每個角色的全部場次（最多最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場），位置理論與最終勝率用他的全部場次，場數越少越接近全體平均；角色理論 = Σ 抽到該角色的機率（忠臣 4/10、其他角色各 1/10）× 本人該角色的最終勝率（每個角色看他當該角色的最近 10 場、忠臣 40 場）；位置理論 = Σ 1/10 × 本人該位置的最終勝率；整體理論 = 用生涯全部場次算的角色理論；不到 5 場的角色或位置，用全體的最終勝率補到 5 場
boards.noteEn: Reached 10 games for the first time within the last 90 days (a few earlier games still count as new); the exception: a newcomer has few games, so role theory takes all of their games in each role (at most the last 10, 40 as Loyal Servant) and position theory and final win rate all of their games; the fewer there are the closer the numbers stay to the population; Role theory = Σ chance of being dealt the role (Loyal Servant 4/10, every other role 1/10) × the player's final win rate as that role (over their last 10 games in each role, 40 as Loyal Servant); position theory = Σ 1/10 × their final win rate in that seat; overall theory = the role theory of their whole career; a role or seat with fewer than 5 games is topped up to 5 at the population's final win rate

boards.title: 角色王
boards.period: 各人該角色最近 20 場
boards.periodEn: Each player's last 20 games in the role
boards.note: 近 90 天內有出賽、生涯該角色至少 20 場；比各人該角色最近 20 場的最終勝率，同率者並列、各得稱號
boards.noteEn: Played in the last 90 days, at least 20 career games in the role; best final win rate over the last 20 games in it, players tied at the top all get the title
